purpose: Frozen P per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1: the disjoint union of subset-(a) (calibrated BIB 4-dim vector) and subset-(b) (8 C12 non-target axes), with explicit non-collapse attestation.

non_collapse_attestation.attestation_text: P is the DISJOINT UNION of subset-(a) and subset-(b). Subset-(a) is evaluated under the BIB 4-dim Manhattan aggregate criterion (G_pres_subset_a_a + G_pres_subset_a_b per v0.1 §11.2); subset-(b) is evaluated as 8 independently-gated binary/subjective axes under the joint C12 BROKEN rule. The two subsets are not concatenated into a 12-dim Manhattan. Axes sharing names across subsets (selection_significance / end_of_report_synthesis / lifetime_framing / factual_discipline) are scored under their respective subset's criteria and reported as distinct gates. Factual discipline appears as BIB-4D-4 (functional_completeness) in subset-(a) AND as C12-7 in subset-(b); these are independently scored under different criteria and reported separately.
